panel.title: Holodeck Control
panel.unsaved: The selection has not been saved to the IR yet.
panel.saved: The selection matches the saved IR.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: At-a-glance status for the declarative system and its integrations.

system.title: System
system.description: Choose the target and appearance, save the IR, and review the plan before applying it.

target.title: Installation target
target.description: Home Manager configures an existing user. Existing NixOS applies the complete system profile.

mode.title: Appearance
mode.description: Choose the desired light or dark theme mode recorded in the IR.

plan.title: Plan and apply
plan.description: The backend validates the saved IR and produces a plan. Applying always requires confirmation and opens a terminal for visible logs and privilege prompts.

confirm.title: Confirm apply
confirm.warning: This will run the allowlisted holodeckctl apply command. Review the plan before continuing.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Configuration and authentication open in a visible terminal. The panel displays only non-sensitive metadata.
integrations.tools_description: Run the complete setup assistant or check the health of every integration.

github.title: GitHub
github.description: Configure authentication, an SSH key, and Git routing for personal projects.

gitlab.title: GitLab
gitlab.description: Enter the instance or group URL. Holodeck only starts or reuses glab web OAuth/SSO; it does not create profiles, SSH keys, or Git routing.

aws.title: AWS
aws.description: One SSO flow automatically generates two profiles per account/role: one for us-east-1 and one for us-east-2.
aws.alias_description: Holodeck creates use1 and use2 automatically for each account/role. Here you can keep both, retain only one, or add other regions.
aws.alias_requires_sync: Complete Sign in and resync once to discover the accounts and roles required by the editor.
aws.alias_waiting: Complete the SSO flow in the terminal. This panel will open the aliases and regions editor automatically.
aws.region_help: You can select one or more. Separate them with commas; for example: us-east-1, us-east-2.
aws.region_pending: Pending confirmation. Previous unconfirmed value: {regions}. Choose at least one region to generate profiles.
aws.alias_pending: Profiles remain pending until at least one region is confirmed.

windows.title: Windows VM
windows.description: Control the Dockurr VM declared by NixOS through the windowsvm command.
windows.ready: The helper is available on this system.
windows.install: Requires applying the existing physical NixOS target.
windows.access_description: Holodeck stores the credential privately with the Windows disk.
windows.access_ready_description: The credential is protected and hidden. Open Windows with one click: Holodeck starts the VM, waits for RDP, and automatically repairs an account lockout.
windows.access_pending_resilience: The credential is already stored. On the next launch Holodeck will perform one automatic preparation to prevent future lockouts, then open RDP.
windows.onboarding_description: Choose the username and password once. They stay protected with this VM disk and will not be requested again until Windows is deleted.
windows.manage_access_description: This section is only for intentionally replacing the password or creating a fresh VM.
windows.unlock_confirm_body: Windows will stop and restart. A recoverable data.img copy will be created and a one-time account unlock will be scheduled without changing its password. The copy is removed only if Windows accepts the stored credential or the one entered in the field over RDP.
windows.password_reset_confirm_body: Windows will stop and restart. A recoverable data.img copy will be created, the password will be replaced with the exact textbox value, and RDP will validate it. Your files are preserved; the old copy is removed only when the new password works.
windows.wipe_confirm_title: WIPE WindowsVM deletes all of Windows
windows.wipe_confirm_body: This action is irreversible: it deletes the Windows disk, programs, and internal files, then creates a fresh VM with the username and password inputs. The shared folder and Nix-pinned runtime image are preserved. Type WIPE to enable it.
windows.display_description: Half screen opens at 50% of the display width. Full screen occupies the monitor; both modes retain dynamic resolution.

notice.ir_missing: No saved IR exists yet. Review the defaults and select Save IR to create it.
notice.terminal_opened: Apply opened in a terminal. Follow the build and any privilege prompt there.
notice.integration_terminal: The integration opened in a terminal. Select Refresh when it finishes to update its state.
notice.graphical_action_started: Holodeck is starting Windows and will open RDP automatically when it is ready.
notice.windows_rdp_display_saved: The RDP size was saved. It will be used when opening or starting Windows.
notice.windows_unlock_started: Account unlock opened in a terminal. Wait for Windows to restart and keep the recovery path it displays.
notice.windows_unlock_cancelled: The Windows account state was not changed.
notice.windows_password_reset_started: Password replacement opened in a terminal. Wait for Windows to restart and keep the recovery path it displays.
notice.windows_password_reset_cancelled: The Windows password was not changed.
notice.windows_wipe_started: WIPE WindowsVM opened in a terminal. Follow the deletion and fresh installation there.
notice.windows_wipe_cancelled: WIPE WindowsVM was cancelled; the guest was not deleted.
notice.windows_credentials_unchanged: The stored credential was not changed.
notice.aws_aliases_saved: Local aliases and regions were confirmed and AWS profiles were regenerated, one for each selected region.
notice.aws_sync_waiting: Complete AWS SSO in the terminal. Holodeck Control is waiting and will refresh automatically.
notice.aws_sync_ready: AWS synchronization completed. The aliases and regions editor is ready.

error.backend_missing: holodeckctl is not available on PATH. Install the backend through the Nix profile and reopen this panel.
error.command_not_allowed: The requested action is not in the frontend command allowlist.
error.command_not_started: Noctalia could not start the backend command.
error.invalid_plan: The backend returned a plan with an unsupported target.
error.terminal_not_started: Noctalia could not open the action in a terminal.
error.alias_request_unavailable: Noctalia could not resolve its local directory for preparing aliases.
error.alias_request_failed: Noctalia could not prepare the local alias request: {detail}
error.rdp_credentials_required: Enter a valid Windows username and password for this operation. RDP and Unlock can use the stored credential with an empty field.
error.rdp_request_unavailable: Noctalia could not resolve the private user runtime directory for the one-time RDP credentials.
error.rdp_request_failed: Noctalia could not prepare the one-time RDP credentials: {detail}
error.windows_wipe_confirmation_required: Type exactly WIPE before deleting the Windows VM.
error.aws_region_required: Choose at least one region for {account} · {role}.
error.aws_sync_not_detected: AWS synchronization was not detected after five minutes. Review the terminal output and retry.
